decisions.reason: The bleaching tray blank has low carrying cost and no sign of resolved failure, so its option value still justifies keeping it.
PETG blanks support growing digital orthodontic workflows with unresolved market uncertainty, giving the option a value above its carrying cost.
The UV-curing lacquer is tied to digital manufacturing where adoption uncertainty remains, making the option worth keeping while costs are limited.
The custom hearing protection earmold faces more competition from other options but still has unresolved potential in hearing-care channels, so we keep it with moderate drop risk.
